adversarial|internal/desktop/desktop.go|.why_it_matters: Closing the window or choosing Quit during a multi-file import does not cancel recognition or queue a quit: it only displays the busy message, and all remaining files continue importing. Both close handlers route through the navigation guard, which returns whenever a job is active, so the shutdown cancellation in Service.Close is unreachable until the user separately cancels or waits for the batch and requests quit again. A dedicated close flow can cancel the active import, await its existing cleanup, and then finish quitting without requiring hard interruption of an Apple API.
